events.title: Back Into Spokane. Carefully.
events.thought: Returned to Spokane avoiding the evacuation zones and found the city park and the river genuinely worth the visit.
events.photoCaption: The Spokane River rushing over the lower falls at Riverfront Park in downtown Spokane — basalt rock formations, white water, the historic rail bridge overhead, and the geodesic dome of the former Expo '74 pavilion visible through wildfire smoke haze.
photoNote: Report. Day 40 — Liberty Lake County Park, second night.
Worked back into Spokane for the day, staying well clear of the evacuation areas. The city park is remarkable. The neighborhoods are too.
There is no camp photo. Camp was again at Liberty Lake County Park. The Spokane River is offered in its place.
